project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test a structurally distinct causal source of intraday edge: unusually large NIFTY-versus-SENSEX 15-minute return dislocation followed by observable short-horizon resolution in the opposite NIFTY direction, with VIX confirmation. This is not a relaxation, inversion, or threshold retune of R3N failed-extreme logic.

predecessor_evidence.R3N: Dedicated failed-session-extreme reversion produced only 5 eligible 2023 trades and failed the unchanged gate; 2024 remained unopened.
predecessor_evidence.design_inference: Session-extreme breach is too sparse to carry the required sample size. Cross-market relative dislocation is a different causal event class that can occur away from literal session highs/lows and can therefore be tested without weakening R3N.
not_permitted: automatic inversion of predecessor losing trades

signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
signal.dislocation_definition: NIFTY causal 15-minute return minus SENSEX causal 15-minute return
signal.candidate_direction: opposite sign of the 15-minute NIFTY-minus-SENSEX dislocation; positive dislocation proposes PE, negative dislocation proposes CE
signal.nifty_resolution_condition: NIFTY causal 5-minute return has the candidate trade direction and is nonzero
signal.sensex_resolution_condition: SENSEX causal 5-minute return has the candidate trade direction and is nonzero
signal.vix_confirmation: India VIX causal 5-minute return has the opposite sign to candidate trade direction
signal.session_location_condition: PE requires NIFTY session_pos>=0.55; CE requires NIFTY session_pos<=0.45
signal.same_timestamp_conflict: not applicable because dislocation sign defines one candidate direction; zero dislocation emits WAIT

horizon_router.resolution_strength: absolute NIFTY causal 5-minute return at signal
horizon_router.strength_threshold: previous-126 same-checkpoint median of absolute NIFTY 5-minute return
horizon_router.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after signal

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze R3O configuration and then and only then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3O without opening 2024; preregister a structurally distinct R3P before any R3P output

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
